review_scope: Independent source and exact DT geometry review; observer not executed on the native guest by this reviewer
limitations: The whole wrapper also retains one fixed read-only HMP dump of the private AOP mailbox; the added SMMUv500 function makes no HMP or device MMIO call.
A clean stopped raw snapshot does not establish TBU probe success, firmware state, native DMA exercise, or Android boot.
Geometry comparisons cover each observed base, status address and SID start. SID count is recorded from actual DT and fixed model geometry, not a separately observed QOM field.
Hardware version and delays remain explicit reference assumptions; the native hardware version and firmware stream/context handoff remain unknown.
Concurrent external resume-and-stop between the two status samples is not detected; the task's native runner is assumed to hold the stopped guest.
